## About
Cain's Brake Annex is the Lincoln Avenue shop in the Cain's family, serving drivers across San Rafael and Marin County. We work on brakes, tires, alignments, lift kits, steering and suspension, and we try to be a no-nonsense place that gives honest advice.
Our sister shop, Cains Tire, is also here in San Rafael. One reviewer told us she brings both her home and business vehicles to us.
We're proud of our 4.7 rating on Google from 31 reviews. If you have a question about your car, give us a call or stop by.

## Services
- Brakes, steering and suspension: Brake work plus steering and suspension repairs to keep your car stopping well and handling the way it should.
- Tires: New tires for your car, with help choosing what fits your driving. One reviewer said the process was easy and quick.
- Alignments and lift kits: Wheel alignments, plus lift kits for drivers who want to raise their vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Do you match prices from other shops?
A: Yes. Our meet or beat policy covers prices from other shops, including Costco, Sears, Toscalito and Wheel Works.

Q: Will you work with my budget?
A: We try to. One reviewer wrote that Angel is flexible and works with you based on your needs and your budget.

Q: Is there another Cain's location?
A: Yes. Our sister shop, Cains Tire, is also in San Rafael.
